gbm_population_evidence.quote: Arm C, D, \& E: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma (2021 WHO Grade 4), who have not received any tumor directed intervention other than biopsy or resection.

candidate_evidence.quote: BDTX-1535 is an inhibitor of EGFR mutations

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Arms A \& B: Recurrent high grade glioma (2021 WHO Grades 3 and 4)
Arm C, D, \& E: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma (2021 WHO Grade 4)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Total BDTX-1535 concentration in Gd enhancing and Gd non-enhancing tumor tissue will be determined by a validated liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) method.
During surgery, blood, tumor, and CSF samples will be collected to measure the amount of drug that is present in the samples.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: BDTX-1535 treated tumor tissue collected during Phase 0 surgery will be compared to archival tissue (baseline) to determine change in pEGFR expression.

role_evidence.quote: This study will administer the investigational drug, BDTX-1535 to eligible patients with recurrent high-grade glioma (HGG) and newly-diagnosed glioblastoma (nGBM).

arms: Arm A: Recurrent High-Grade Glioma Participants with EGFR Alterations
Arm B: Recurrent High-Grade Glioma Participants with EGFR Fusion
Arm C: Newly-Diagnosed GBM Participants with EGFR Alterations (OBD Determination)
Arm D: Newly-Diagnosed GBM Participants with EGFR Alterations (BDTX-1535 + RT Safety)
Arm E: Newly-Diagnosed GBM Participants with EGFR Alterations (Stupp protocol)

agents.agent_name_registered: temozolomide (standard of care TMZ in Arm E)

role_evidence.quote: During Phase 1, BDTX-1535 concurrently with standard of care upfront RT and TMZ, followed by adjuvant BDTX-1535 combined with standard of care TMZ continuously in 28-day cycles after RT.

arms: Arm E: Newly-Diagnosed GBM Participants with EGFR Alterations (Stupp protocol)

source_quote.quote: The tissue must have evidence of EGFR alterations including variants, fusion, and mutations with or without amplifications.
Participants with unmethylated MGMT promoter tumors demonstrating PK response will proceed to the Phase 1 Expansion component.

arms: Arm C: Newly-Diagnosed GBM Participants with EGFR Alterations (OBD Determination)
Arm D: Newly-Diagnosed GBM Participants with EGFR Alterations (BDTX-1535 + RT Safety)
Arm E: Newly-Diagnosed GBM Participants with EGFR Alterations (Stupp protocol)

source_quote.quote: BDTX-1535 treated tumor tissue collected during Phase 0 surgery will be compared to archival tissue (baseline) to determine change in pEGFR expression.
BDTX-1535 treated tumor tissue collected during Phase 0 surgery will be compared to archival tissue (baseline) to determine change in pERK expression.
Tumor tissue collected during Phase 0 surgery will be compared to archival tissue (baseline) to assess fold induction change of ClCas-3, MIB-1, and pS6.

coder_notes: Registered as EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). MGMT status determines which newly diagnosed participants proceed to Phase 1 expansion (unmethylated in Arms C and D, methylated in Arm E). Phase 1 expansion adds radiotherapy (all NDGBM arms) and temozolomide (Arm E); regimen coded combination. Recurrent HGG cohorts (Arms A, B) are grade 3 and 4 glioma; GBM is named in conditions and the NDGBM arms.
